name: Hodad's Ocean Beach
menu_notes: Verified against the official source_url (hodadsoceanbeach.com food menu page). All burger and extras prices matched exactly (Guido Burger $18, Blue Jay Burger $18, Double Bacon Cheeseburger $28, Small/Large Fry $11.25/$18, Onion Rings $22, Frings $30, etc.). One inconsistency: 'Single Bacon Cheeseburger' is listed twice in our data at two different prices.
data_notes: Address/city/neighborhood (5010 Newport Ave, Ocean Beach) are correct. Hours in our data show 11am-10pm every day; one independent aggregator (Yelp-adjacent search result) suggested an 11am-9pm close, which conflicts and should be double-checked directly against the restaurant rather than a snippet.
issues: Duplicate item: 'Single Bacon Cheeseburger' appears once in the 'Favorites' section at $17.00 and again in the 'Burgers' section at $17.50 -- the real menu only has it once, at $17.50. The $17.00 Favorites entry is stale/wrong.
Closing time (10pm vs a reported 9pm close) could not be conclusively confirmed and should be re-checked.
